description: Unchanged published final policies under observation-derived MotionError. A fresh evaluation is required; historical scores are not results of this interface.

memory.name: stage
memory.description: pick | place | flip | done

memory.name: home
memory.description: initial 7-D ee poses [left, right] recorded at the first decision; arms return here after every placement/flip

memory.name: tray
memory.description: battery tray centroid [x, y] measured from the head camera at the first decision (empty tray)

memory.name: placed
memory.description: arms whose battery has been carried to the tray

memory.name: holding
memory.description: arms that picked a battery and still have to place it, in placement order

memory.name: flips_done
memory.description: number of orientation flips issued; arm = [left, right][flips_done % 2] (cyclic Gray code)

memory.name: pick_attempts
memory.description: table pick attempts (initial + retries, max 3)

memory.name: needle
memory.description: dashboard needle state at this decision: up | rotated | unknown

memory.name: last_action
memory.description: tool and note of the previous decision

memory.name: decisions
memory.description: decisions taken this episode

memory.name: history
memory.description: short log of decisions

memory.name: slots
memory.description: three cube slot centres [x,y] (sorted by x) detected at reset

memory.name: button
memory.description: button centre [x,y] detected at reset

memory.name: arrangement
memory.description: believed cube ids per slot (A,B,C as at reset; _ = empty)

memory.name: temp_cube
memory.description: id of the cube parked at the temporary spot during a swap

memory.name: tried
memory.description: arrangements already pressed without success

memory.name: swap
memory.description: slot indices of the swap in progress

memory.name: stage
memory.description: init/press/pressed/choose/move1/move2/move3

memory.name: press_fail
memory.description: consecutive presses whose depth was not confirmed

memory.name: stall
memory.description: consecutive move decisions whose result was not yet verified

memory.name: decisions
memory.description: decisions taken this episode

memory.name: note
memory.description: last decision summary

memory.name: colors_lr
memory.description: block colour in each slot, left->right in the head view (increasing world x); read once before lids hide the blocks

memory.name: block_xy
memory.description: world xy of each block slot (nominal unless clearly displaced in the first head RGB-D frame)

memory.name: lid_xy
memory.description: world xy of each lid's original handle position; lids are returned here when uncovering

memory.name: task_idx
memory.description: index into plan: cover slot0, slot1, slot2, uncover red, green, blue, finish

memory.name: active_arm
memory.description: arm currently away from home: left, right or none

memory.name: retries
memory.description: retries spent on the current plan step

memory.name: home_checked
memory.description: whether the arm was parked to re-check a failed uncover verification

memory.name: pending
memory.description: kind of macro just executed (cover, uncover, home, finish, none) to verify next decision

memory.name: notes
memory.description: last verification result and chosen macro

memory.name: phase
memory.description: current phase of the pick state machine (observe/perceive/pregrasp/descend/close/lift/check/retreat)

memory.name: target_desc
memory.description: shelf target descriptor seen at reset: height cm, length cm, width cm, R-G, B-G, brightness

memory.name: target_seen
memory.description: whether the shelf target was observed before the screen hid it

memory.name: arm
memory.description: arm chosen for the grasp (left/right)

memory.name: grasp
memory.description: grasp plan: x, y (m), grasp-centre height above table (m), yaw (rad)

memory.name: home_left
memory.description: left ee pose at reset

memory.name: home_right
memory.description: right ee pose at reset

memory.name: attempts
memory.description: failed grasp attempts so far

memory.name: gz_adjust
memory.description: grasp-height correction from earlier attempts (m): +0.01 after an unreachable descent, -0.008 after a missed grasp

memory.name: failed
memory.description: table xy where grasps failed repeatedly

memory.name: near_count
memory.description: head-camera points of the chosen object on the table before grasping

memory.name: near_other
memory.description: head-camera points of neighbouring objects inside the check radius before grasping

memory.name: lift_extra
memory.description: extra lifts performed after the object left the table

memory.name: log
memory.description: last decision note

memory.name: origins
memory.description: World [x, y] of every red block on its blue mat at the first observation, sorted left to right (ascending x). Set once; the place-back targets.

memory.name: idx
memory.description: Index into origins of the block currently being cycled.

memory.name: stage
memory.description: to_green (block idx must go to the green mat), to_origin (back to its own blue mat) or done.

memory.name: phase
memory.description: pick: next decision perceives and grasps; place: the previous act was act_pick and the next act places (if holding).

memory.name: arm
memory.description: Arm used for the current block: left for origins x<0, right otherwise.

memory.name: green
memory.description: World [x, y] centre of the green mat measured at the first observation.

memory.name: home_left
memory.description: Left end-effector reset pose (x,y,z,qw,qx,qy,qz) from the first observation.

memory.name: home_right
memory.description: Right end-effector reset pose (x,y,z,qw,qx,qy,qz) from the first observation.

memory.name: fails
memory.description: Consecutive act_place calls whose carry motion could not be planned (block still held); after MAX_FAILS the arm goes home and releases.

memory.name: lost
memory.description: Consecutive decisions in which the current block was not detected; after MAX_LOST the block is skipped.

memory.name: note
memory.description: Human-readable reason for the last decision.

memory.name: stage
memory.description: read | pressing | done

memory.name: left_number
memory.description: number on the left tile, read once from the reset head image = presses of the left button

memory.name: right_number
memory.description: number on the right tile, read once from the reset head image = presses of the middle button

memory.name: reading
memory.description: digit classifier scores/margins for diagnosis

memory.name: read_tries
memory.description: reset-frame reading attempts

memory.name: left_presses
memory.description: verified presses of the left button

memory.name: mid_presses
memory.description: verified presses of the middle button

memory.name: right_presses
memory.description: verified presses of the right (confirm) button

memory.name: confirm_tries
memory.description: confirm-press attempts issued

memory.name: pending
memory.description: button the previous act tried to press (left|mid|right|none); verified next decision

memory.name: buttons
memory.description: press targets [x, y, dz] for left/middle/right buttons from the reset head RGB-D

memory.name: home_left
memory.description: left ee reset pose [x,y,z,qw,qx,qy,qz]; parking pose before the right arm confirms

memory.name: home_right
memory.description: right ee reset pose [x,y,z,qw,qx,qy,qz]

memory.name: note
memory.description: button-localisation note

memory.name: pre_pose
memory.description: pose [x,y,z,q] of the pressing arm when the last press act was issued; start of the press-verification sequence

memory.name: phase
memory.description: current phase: init, pick1, place_center, press, pick2, place_back, done

memory.name: origin
memory.description: original block top-face centre [x,y,top_z] seen at reset (the place to return to)

memory.name: center
memory.description: centre of the four-mat arrangement [x,y]

memory.name: button
memory.description: button top centre [x,y,top_z] seen at reset

memory.name: block_arm
memory.description: arm that moves the block

memory.name: press_arm
memory.description: arm that presses the button

memory.name: home_left
memory.description: left arm reset pose [[x,y,z],[qw,qx,qy,qz]]

memory.name: home_right
memory.description: right arm reset pose [[x,y,z],[qw,qx,qy,qz]]

memory.name: block_pos
memory.description: latest perceived block top-face centre [x,y,top_z] used for the next grasp

memory.name: attempts
memory.description: retries of the current phase

memory.name: press_extra
memory.description: extra press depth in metres added after a shallow press

memory.name: pressed
memory.description: button depression was observed

memory.name: history
memory.description: compact log of phase outcomes

memory.name: phase
memory.description: start, picked1, placed1, pressed, picked2, placed2, done

memory.name: table_z
memory.description: table surface height from head depth at reset (m)

memory.name: block_first
memory.description: [x, y, top_z] of the block that started between the mats (updated on retry)

memory.name: block_second
memory.description: [x, y, top_z] of the block that started on a mat

memory.name: empty_mat
memory.description: [x, y] centre of the mat that was empty at reset

memory.name: occupied_mat
memory.description: [x, y] centre of the mat that held a block at reset

memory.name: mid_target
memory.description: [x, y] midpoint between the two mat centres

memory.name: button
memory.description: [x, y] centre of the button top

memory.name: home
memory.description: initial [left_ee_pose, right_ee_pose] (7 values each) used as retreat poses

memory.name: retries
memory.description: re-pick attempts used in the current phase

memory.name: log
memory.description: short note of the last decision

memory.name: phase
memory.description: state-machine phase: init, check_pick, place, verify

memory.name: red_start
memory.description: red block start [x, y, table_z] (m), perceived once at reset; blue goal

memory.name: red_start_yaw
memory.description: red block start yaw (rad, crossbar->stem-tip direction); blue goal yaw

memory.name: blue_start
memory.description: blue block start [x, y, table_z] (m), perceived once at reset; red goal

memory.name: blue_start_yaw
memory.description: blue block start yaw (rad); red goal yaw

memory.name: table_z
memory.description: perceived table height (m)

memory.name: home_left
memory.description: left ee reset pose, 7 numbers x,y,z,qw,qx,qy,qz (carry/park pose)

memory.name: home_right

memory.description: retries of the current placement after motion errors

memory.name: repicks
memory.description: re-pick attempts used

memory.name: corrections
memory.description: post-placement corrections used

memory.name: waits
memory.description: hold decisions used
